description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams' that extends a base 'FilterParams' class, encapsulating filtering and sorting parameters for leave type search operations within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave type search results, allowing filtering by name and setting a default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveType.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the current filter value for 'name'.
